name: Reborn As Swordman
seoDescription: Find the latest Reborn As Swordman codes to unlock boosts, pets, and auras that sharpen your training and battles in this Roblox clicker game.
introMd: Reborn As Swordman is a clicker game where you start weak and train to become a powerful swordsman by defeating enemies and bosses. Codes in this game give you boosts and special items that help speed up your progress. Using these codes smartly can give you extra Wins, Train, and Luck boosts, or even pets and auras to improve your gameplay and show off. If you want to get stronger faster or grab some cool extras, knowing the right codes is key.
redeemMd:
## How to Redeem Reborn As Swordman Codes
There are no special requirements to redeem codes. Just follow these simple steps:
1. [[roblox_link|Launch Reborn As Swordman]].
2. Click the Store button on the left side of the screen.
3. Scroll down to the bottom of the Store menu.
4. Enter your code exactly as shown in the CODE box.
5. Press Redeem to claim your rewards immediately.
rewardsMd:
## What Rewards You Normally Get?
Codes in Reborn As Swordman mostly grant boosts and special items that directly affect your training and combat efficiency. Here are the typical rewards you can expect:

| Reward Type       | Description                                                                                 |
|-------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Wins Boost        | Doubles the number of wins you earn, helping you unlock better weapons and items faster.   |
| Train Boost       | Doubles your training speed, so you gain strength quicker during clicking sessions.        |
| Luck Boost        | Doubles luck, increasing chances for better drops and rewards.                              |
| Pet Equip         | Adds an extra pet equip slot, allowing you to use more pets for stronger boosts.           |
| Pets              | Grants special pets like the Pet Parrot or Diminutive Imp, which provide unique bonuses.    |
| Auras             | Gives special auras such as Purified Special Aura or Stinky Aura that offer visual effects.|
| Scrolls of Pet    | Provides scrolls used to obtain random pets, expanding your pet collection.                 |

These rewards are unique to the game and help you progress by enhancing your combat and training abilities or by adding cosmetic flair.
troubleshootMd:
## Why Codes Might Not Work
Codes in Reborn As Swordman are case sensitive, so typing them exactly as shown is crucial. If a code doesn’t work, it’s usually because of incorrect capitalization or the code has expired. Always double-check spelling and letter case before trying again.
findCodesMd:

New codes for Reborn As Swordman are usually shared by the developer Alan Studio on their official Discord and the Reborn As Swordman Guilded server. Codes drop occasionally during updates or special events. Following the developer’s socials below is the best way to catch fresh codes as soon as they release.
